speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Dr Tan See Leng)
text: The Ministry of Manpower (MOM) champions human potential for a thriving Singapore.

speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Dr Tan See Leng)
text: Our future economy is being reshaped by global trends and the transformative potential of artificial intelligence (AI).

speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Dr Tan See Leng)
text: Workers will live longer, with more diverse career aspirations and evolving needs across life stages.

speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Dr Tan See Leng)
text: Our future workplaces will need to support technology-enabled jobs and multi-stage careers.

speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Dr Tan See Leng)
text: Amid these challenges and disruptions, we must collectively shape a future of work that enables growth, fulfillment and diverse pathways to success.

speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Dr Tan See Leng)
text: MOM's priority is to empower Singaporeans to thrive in the new economy.

speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Dr Tan See Leng)
text: We will help them unlock their potential by deepening skills and expertise, mapping career pathways and connecting them to opportunities that make the most of their abilities.

speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Dr Tan See Leng)
text: As Singaporeans live longer, their careers will increasingly span multiple stages.

speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Dr Tan See Leng)
text: MOM will help citizens adapt to this change by encouraging flexible work, promoting multi-generational workplaces, and enabling better balance between work and personal priorities.

speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Dr Tan See Leng)
text: As seniors remain active in the workforce for longer, they will also be able to save more for retirement.

speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Dr Tan See Leng)
text: At the same time, we will continue to provide support for those who, despite their best efforts, may not be able to set aside enough – through schemes like the Workfare Income Supplement, the Matched Retirement Savings Scheme and the Silver Support Scheme.

speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Dr Tan See Leng)
text: We will also continue to provide options for those who want to save more in their CPF.

speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Dr Tan See Leng)
text: MOM will support businesses to build talent in three ways.

speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Dr Tan See Leng)
text: First, adopting skills-first hiring to unlock new talent pools.

speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Dr Tan See Leng)
text: Second, creating rich career development and progression opportunities within the firm to stretch and retain talent.

speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Dr Tan See Leng)
text: We have launched the Tripartite Workgroup on Human Capital Capability Development to drive this work.

speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Dr Tan See Leng)
text: We will support Singaporeans in gaining global exposure for professional development and future leadership, through programmes like the Overseas Markets Immersion Programme.

speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Dr Tan See Leng)
text: At the same time, we will refine our foreign workforce policies so that businesses can bring in talent that complements our Singaporean core and ultimately create more jobs and opportunities for our people.

speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Dr Tan See Leng)
text: MOM will strive for growth that is fairer, safer and more inclusive.

speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Dr Tan See Leng)
text: We will update the Employment Act to ensure adequate protections for different groups of workers, to keep up with new workplace and technological trends, while streamlining compliance for businesses.

speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Dr Tan See Leng)
text: Platform workers are now covered under the Platform Workers Act and a trilateral platform has also been set up to address challenges faced by platform workers.

speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Dr Tan See Leng)
text: With increasingly diverse forms of work and work arrangements, we will study how to better support platform workers, self-employed persons and freelancers in terms of workplace protections, reskilling and career pathways.

speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Dr Tan See Leng)
text: Lower-wage workers can look forward to continued wage increases under the Progressive Wage Model and more support to upskill and reskill via the Workfare Skills Support.

speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Dr Tan See Leng)
text: We will also professionalise skilled trades, so that our economy provides multiple pathways to success.

speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Dr Tan See Leng)
text: MOM will work with other government agencies and stakeholders to build an empowered workforce and thriving workplaces.

speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Dr Tan See Leng)
text: We will support Singaporeans to face future challenges and chart out their future paths for success.
